elements.label: On the Fringes of Britain
elements.description: In these days as the skin of the world gradually weakens, nights grow longer, and the boundaries between reality and the Bounds begin to blur. These were once paths and hills I knew well, yet now they often emanate an unsettling sense of unfamiliarity.

elements.label: Caen in the Midst of War
elements.description: The conflict did not cease in my absence. As the war worsens, the skin of the world cracked and fragmented, and abhorrent things poured forth from its wounds... It is time to leave.

elements.label: London
elements.description: The army anxiously awaits reports from the front lines, while the council is in turmoil over the false news of my death... I shall find a way to reassure them, though not with a truly grand or public return.

elements.label: London
elements.description: Transportation has nearly collapsed after months of bombing, and most buildings have been toppled and crushed beyond recognition. Convenience is a thing of the past—it’s time to personally reclaim what can still be used.

elements.label: Glasgow
elements.description: Since the Great Depression that began years ago and persists to this day, gangs and adept organizations have become malignant growths entrenched deep in this city. As the war situation worsened, their illicit activities have—bafflingly—grown in scale and audacity to such an extent that even some intriguing rumors have reached my ears. Perhaps a field visit might indeed yield a few unexpected findings.

elements.label: Glasgow
elements.description: The chaos of wartime mobilization has become the perfect cover for illegal operations—while factories run at full capacity and supplies are strictly rationed, adepts and mobsters are busy running black markets in the shadows. This is far more biting than many satirical novels I've read.

elements.label: Powys
elements.description: In some uncertain day of the distant past, an aged yet ever-moving traveler passed through the hills and mountains of this land. It is said that she left behind a gift for a sovereign yet to come, hidden somewhere in a deep, secret cave—and that gift still awaits discovery. If the tale holds true, perhaps it could improve my current situation.

elements.label: Powys
elements.description: Across the vast hills and plains, the sounds of soldiers drilling echo with the wind. Herds of livestock are driven by shepherds and farmers, hastily retreating into the distance. Someone must always be sacrificed for war.

elements.label: Belfast
elements.description: Ever since the north fell under the shadow of war, my loyal future Name—or so he firmly believes—has been steadfastly protecting our vassal's capital along the coastline, never leaving its side. That is, until he was buried under rubble by an unexpected airstrike, and the locals couldn’t even manage to free him themselves. We’d better not keep him waiting too long.

elements.label: Belfast
elements.description: There was once a foolish and naive belief that the areas west of the North Strait would “never be directly affected, no matter what.” Yet the still-burning shells in this city have made the situation all too clear. No one can remain untouched by war.

elements.label: Dover
elements.description: Since the Great Retreat concluded, it has been several months since I last heard from my ally in Dover—the one who has committed the Crime of the Sky. If this alone weren't strange enough, his failure to write and complain about our declining control over the skies is even more bewildering. If I set out now to uncover the truth, perhaps I can still recover some of his legacy.

elements.label: Dover
elements.description: The Great Retreat — it was indeed a humiliation that we had to carry it out, yet the White Cliffs of Dover will bear witness to Britain fighting to the last breath on sea and in the air. Britain has retreated in war more than once before, but not today, not here.

elements.label: Northumberland
elements.description: On a night when the artillery fire ceased for a moment, a pearl was washed ashore along a coastline bristling with fortresses and gun emplacements—glowing as if it belonged to another era. Yet each of its successive owners had met their end by drowning. Artifacts of such potent enchantment are rare; its power shall be mine.

elements.label: Northumberland
elements.description: This place was once revered by followers of the Witch-and-Sister as the ‘City of Pearls.’ Whatever they beheld then must have been vastly different from what now lies before me. The tides of time wash over all, leaving but the slightest traces unchanged.

elements.label: Edinburgh
elements.description: A friend serving in the Church of the Sun arranged to meet me here. I hope he hasn’t brought along a companion from Italy—I’d rather not miss our meeting or waste time because of it.

elements.label: Edinburgh
elements.description: Months on, disturbances against local Italians persist. Now, every few steps down the street, one passes a smashed building. Mortal trifles always reduce due efficiency.

elements.label: Destiny to Unknow
elements.description: Keep going forward and step into the unknown road......
